1

The development at a glance

Source: the agency's development overview & developer brochure

Idyllic is built in two independent phases on separate plots, each with its own private communal areas: Idyllic 1 (Parcela G1) and Idyllic 2 (Parcela F1). Unit B sits in Idyllic 2 — Parcela F1, Sector SURO-O3 “Arroyo de Enmedio Este”, Estepona.

  • F1 promotion: 37 homes plus garages, storage rooms and a pool (per the Unit B plan title block).
  • Homes: 2, 3 and 4 bedrooms — ground floors with private gardens, mid-floor apartments with spacious terraces, and penthouses with large solariums. Built surfaces from approx. 82 m² to over 140 m².
  • Architecture: contemporary, with large windows for natural light and views to the gardens; layouts designed to maximise functionality, with terraces extending the living areas.
  • Communal areas: landscaped gardens with automatic irrigation; infinity adults’ pool and children’s pool (saline chlorination, interior lighting); spa with sauna, Turkish bath and jacuzzi; gym / fitness area; community room with coworking space and games / multimedia room; relaxation and yoga area; picnic area.
  • Lifts: OTIS Génesis (or similar).

Location & distances

Brochure claims · Dec 2024 — developer figures, not independently measured

The development sits in Arroyo Enmedio / La Gaspara, an established residential area of Estepona, approx. 800 m from the nearest beach and close to the A-7 coastal road linking Estepona with Marbella and Málaga Airport. Seven or more golf courses lie within 7 km.

Crossing the A-7 on foot

La Gaspara’s footbridge by the Hotel Elba crosses the A-7 to Playa de la Gaspara and the Senda Litoral coastal path — it has both stairs and a smooth ramp (walked by Anton and Mariana); and a second footbridge is under construction. Just east and west sit the Arroyo Vaquero and Guadalobón crossings (Ministry of Transport network, A-7 km 158–163), including the wooden footbridge over the Arroyo Vaquero (Bahía Dorada ↔ Avenida de México) and spans toward the Mercadona retail hub.

5

Unit B — Block 1, Portal 2

Source: Unit B floor plan, provisional, 16-04-2025 · full read 23 Oct 2026

A 4-bed / 3-bath duplex penthouse: living space and three bedrooms on Planta 2ª, a self-contained fourth-bedroom suite and the solarium on the Ático level, joined by an internal stair. It sits at the south end of Block 1 (the western block), with the pool gardens at the centre of the plot. Per the plan’s north arrow, the long terrace faces ≈ south (the sea direction) and the bedroom-front terrace ≈ east — morning sun, garden side. Partial sea views from living-room level are now visually evidenced: a video filmed on site (provided by Anton, 24 Oct 2026) pans from the living-room-level terrace and, zooming between the neighbouring blocks, shows the sea on the horizon — a partial/slot view, not a panoramic one. This is consistent with the earlier sightline analysis. From the solarium level the sea view is full: a second video filmed on site from the solarium (provided by Anton, 24 Oct 2026) shows a wide band of sea along the horizon — far more open than the living-room-level slot. What remains to be confirmed is only the final extent of the view once the neighbouring blocks are finished.

  • Price: €995,000 ex-VAT / €1,094,500 incl. 10% VAT — developer price via Anastasiia (Acapulco Centro), October 2026.
  • Total útil 335.35 m² (derived from the printed figures), of which 65% is outdoor space.
  • Parking & storage (developer allocation, 23 Oct 2026): 2 garage spaces — G1-01 and G1-02; 2 storage rooms (trasteros) — T1-02 and T1-03.

Percentages sum to 100% of the €1,094,500 incl.-VAT price; pre-completion payments total €328,350 incl. VAT (derived). The completion tranche is where the mortgage lands.

Draft PPC required Draft PPC required before signing the reserva. The PPC follows only 30 days after the reserva, so the draft PPC (contrato de compraventa) must be in hand and reviewed BEFORE the reserva is signed — its terms (the aval guaranteeing every pre-completion payment, the contractual delivery date and delay penalties, the stage-payment schedule, the pool annex and the Hogariza addendum) cannot be negotiated from inside that 30-day window.
Developer-offered extra — a pool on the solarium. During the negotiations the developer offered — their own initiative — to build a pool on Unit B’s solarium, worth about €38,000. The exact position on the 97.15 m² solarium, the type and the look are still to be determined. (Reported by Anton from the negotiations, 23 Oct 2026.) The groundwork is partly there: the quality specification already includes a water tap on the terraces and a pre-installation for a future shower in the solarium.
Missing living-room exit (noted on the plan): the provisional plan shows no opening from the living room onto the southern part of the terrace along the south wall — the bedrooms open onto their terrace, but the living room does not. Emilio, CEO of the buyer’s agency (Acapulco Centro), has written that the agency’s own team can create the opening: the window/door unit costs approximately €2,000–€3,000 (paid by the buyers); creating the opening, removing the rubble and making good costs another €2,000–€3,000, which Emilio will cover entirely as a personal gesture thanking the buyers for their patience. (Reported by Anton, 23 Oct 2026.)

Build specification

Source: the quality specifications (memoria de calidades) PDF
  • Structure: reinforced concrete walls, pillars and slabs; foundations per the geotechnical study.
  • Walls: exterior enclosure of plastered brick with an air chamber, polyurethane-foam insulation and plasterboard lining. Party walls between homes: brick with plaster / plasterboard both sides. Interior partitions: 15 mm laminated plasterboard on galvanized steel framing.
  • Terraces: brick parapets combined with 8+8.2 Stadip glass railing fronts and wood-slat composite panels in places.
  • Flooring: 60.5 × 60.5 cm ceramic throughout the interior; outdoor stoneware on terraces; bathroom tiling 30.5 × 90 cm.
  • Windows & doors: Cortizo COR 60 windows and COR4900 balcony doors — aluminium with thermal break, double glazing, safety glass in low areas. Armoured entrance door with security lock. Wardrobes lined in textile-simil melamine with hanging bars and a 60 cm drawer unit per bedroom.
  • Climate & hot water: ducted hot/cold air conditioning to the living room and bedrooms (indoor unit housed in a bathroom or laundry false ceiling; outdoor unit on the roof). Domestic hot water by a centralized aerothermal system — matching the plan’s shared installations room with two DHW accumulators. Renewable electricity generation as required by the building code (CTE).
  • Plumbing extras: water tap on the terraces; pre-installation for a future shower in the solarium; bi-thermal connections for washing machine and dishwasher; soundproofed downpipes; partial shut-offs per wet room.
  • Bathrooms: main bathroom — suspended toilet, extra-flat mineral-load shower tray, double-sink furniture in walnut finish, TRES taps. Secondary bathrooms — Gala sanitaryware and furniture, CANIGÓ taps; acrylic bath where the design includes one; fixed tempered-glass shower screens.
  • Kitchen: fully furnished with floor-to-ceiling units (matt white or natural-wood laminate), Compac worktop with matching upstand, LED strip lighting under the wall units. Balay (or similar) appliances included: induction hob, multifunction oven, integrated extractor hood, microwave, fridge, integrated dishwasher; stainless-steel sink.
  • Electrics & comms: TV and phone points in all bedrooms, living room and kitchen; TV socket and double socket on the terraces; video intercom with automatic pedestrian-door opening; LED lighting in communal corridors and stairwells.

8

Open questions — to verify at reserva / PPC

Carried from the Oct 2026 developer dossier
Pre-reserva confirmation list To be confirmed before the reserva is signed — Anton’s rule, 23 Oct 2026: all of this, and more, gets confirmed first; the reserva signature is the checkpoint.

  1. Draft PPC in hand and reviewed before the reserva is signed (Anton’s requirement, 23 Oct 2026). The PPC is signed 30 days after the reserva, so its full terms must be checked before any signature.

  2. Lawyer engagement. The money flow is settled: the developer pays none of these professionals — the lawyer, the mortgage broker and the other purchase professionals are paid/hired by Acapulco Centro out of what Anton and Mariana pay the agency. The remaining check is the engagement itself: confirm that the lawyer is instructed by, and reports to, Anton and Mariana, since the draft PPC, aval and licence review all run through this lawyer; likewise confirm the mortgage broker’s terms and lender panel.

  3. Building licence number. The agency states the licence is granted, but the number is unpublished — obtain it and confirm it covers Parcela F1 / Block 1.

  4. Definitive plan & surfaces. Get the non-provisional (proyecto definitivo) plan for Unit B and confirm nothing moved from the 16-04-2025 provisional figures.

  5. Reserva & PPC terms. Stage-payment schedule — now known (developer payment terms, via Anton, 23 Oct 2026; see the Payment schedule in section 5): reserva €6,600 incl. VAT; PPC signed 30 days after the reserva with 20% + VAT payable less the reserva already paid (€212,300 net, derived); 5% + VAT (€54,725, derived) on 15 February 2027; 5% + VAT (€54,725, derived) on 15 June 2027; 70% + VAT (€766,150, derived) at completion. Still to confirm: an individual bank guarantee (aval) for every pre-completion payment; the contractual delivery date and delay penalties (Q4 2027 is the listing figure — get it in the contract); what is included (garage space number, storage room — answered: 2 garage spaces, G1-01 and G1-02, and 2 storage rooms, T1-02 and T1-03, per the developer allocation reported by Anton, 23 Oct 2026); community-fee and IBI estimates. Follow-up: the G1/T1 numbering resembles the Idyllic 1 (Parcela G1) naming while Unit B is in Idyllic 2 (Parcela F1) — confirm where the two garage spaces and two storage rooms physically sit.

  6. Sea-view confirmation — answered at both levels. The living-room-level partial view is evidenced: a video filmed on site (provided by Anton, 24 Oct 2026) shows the sea on the horizon between the neighbouring blocks from the living-room-level terrace — a partial/slot view, not a panoramic one. The solarium-level view is also evidenced: a second video filmed from the solarium (provided by Anton, 24 Oct 2026) shows a full sea view — a wide band of sea along the horizon. What remains to confirm is only the final extent of the view once the surrounding blocks are finished.

  7. Energy certificate rating. Shown in the agency’s materials but the rating was not legible in the extracted text — obtain it.

  8. The solarium pool offer — in writing. The developer’s offer (reported by Anton from the negotiations, 23 Oct 2026) must be captured in writing in the reserva / PPC annex: the commitment itself, the ~€38,000 value, the specification — position, type, dimensions, structure / waterproofing / drainage — once chosen, and who bears any extra costs.

  9. The living-room terrace opening — OPEN. To confirm with Emilio (Acapulco Centro) and the builder (Hercesa), sooner rather than later: after construction there will be extra obstacles (community consent for a facade change, works licence, warranty effects), so whether the opening can be incorporated during construction as a project modification needs an answer early. Pin down in writing with Emilio (CEO, Acapulco Centro): the cost split as quoted — door unit €2,000–€3,000 paid by the buyers, opening works €2,000–€3,000 covered by Emilio personally; when the work happens (during construction as a project modification vs after handover); who consents (the facade is a common element — developer and community-of-owners consent; possible municipal works licence); and the effect on the developer’s build warranty if the facade is cut after handover. This question remains open until Emilio and the builder answer it.

  10. The complete personalization / inclusions sheet for Unit B. The copy on file cuts off at the Pintura row; obtain the full sheet, including any lines below it and the asterisk footnote.
